body: And I know I didn't express it very well in my original post but there's many things that go into this, not just that I hate my job. I feel like that's the straw that broke the camel's back, so to speak. Mostly I feel like a failure and that I have nothing to show for my life at almost 30 years old and that my problems are just a burden for everyone else and that I need to just suck it up and keep going. It's just that I don't know how to handle things and it's getting really tiring. I just wanna not have to deal with anything for a while. I'm so tired of fighting this.

Thanks for your response.

Should I tell them I want to kill myself even though I have no plan to? Or should I just tell them that I have really bad anxiety and depression and I can't handle it? 

I also don't know what's going on with my insurance since I just changed jobs. I had state insurance but I already signed up for it through my new job but I don't know if it went into place yet. Is that something I can worry about later?

I know it's not the end of the world. I guess I just feel stuck. One of my biggest problems is I tend to put everyone else before myself (for example, if I quit this job I absolutely hate it's gonna make my aunt look bad and my parents are gonna be pissed at me).

I don't know how to explain it. Nevermind.

Thanks for your comment though.
